recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, desaturated close-up portrait of a male subject looking downward, overlaid with a geometric red graphic element and a structured grid of halftone dots, featuring bold lowercase typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome photography contrasted with a single vibrant red accent color
Soft photographic textures against sharp geometric vector shapes
Heavy lowercase typography anchored to a horizontal baseline across the lower third
Repetitive dot grid pattern providing a mid-ground layer between subject and text
coreInvariants: Vibrant red as the primary graphic accent

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait occupying the top-left and center, cropped tightly to the face and shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red geometric shape and the bold white name across the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes looking down, follows the gaze to the red graphic, then moves left-to-right across the primary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the background and clothing provide dark negative space for the white text to pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Grayscale/Black for the photographic base and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for primary display typography and barcode area.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red for geometric shapes and secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between deep blacks and bright whites, with a high-saturation red punch.

letterConstructionRules: Strictly lowercase for all display elements
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and colors (white and red).

candidateDirections.reason: Classic clean sans-serif with similar lowercase proportions.
Provides the necessary weight and urban feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, desaturated black and white portrait of a man looking down, with deep shadows. Overlay a semi-transparent grid of small gray dots in the center. Add a sharp, stylized red geometric shape resembling a horizontal lightning bolt or wing on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold lowercase sans-serif text in white across the lower third, overlapping the red shape. Add a small row of metadata text at the very bottom in white. Place a white barcode box in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the red shape vibrant and sharp-edged?
Is the dot grid visible but not distracting?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red accent color

mustAchieve: Balanced layering of pattern, shape, and photo

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast black and white balance
Ensure the red graphic does not obscure the subject's face
Confirm the halftone grid is aligned to a square axis
recipe.reuseFormula: Grayscale Portrait + Red Geometric Overlay + Halftone Grid + Bold Lowercase Sans-Serif = Urban R&B Aesthetic
